plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Exit high-risk tech names (SMCI, SNOW, CRWD) completely.
Reduce QQQI allocation to 20% to lower concentration.
Hold remaining broad index and income ETFs.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation.
Expect lower volatility and modest returns.
conservative.read: This conservative mode focuses on capital preservation by cutting leveraged ETFs and high-risk tech. Expect a lower target return of around 1.5% per month with significantly reduced drawdown potential. A larger cash buffer is implicitly held.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to low single digits.
Exit high-risk tech names (SMCI, SNOW, CRWD) completely.
Maintain QQQI at 25% for income.
Hold remaining broad index and quality tech.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth.
Targeting around 2.5% monthly return with controlled risk.
balanced.read: This balanced mode aims for risk-first growth by reducing leverage and exiting high-conviction tech names. Expect a target return of approximately 2.5% per month, with a moderate cash buffer and controlled drawdown. Concentration is reduced.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% and SMH to 8%.
Exit underperforming tech names (CRWD, SNOW, SMCI).
Add SPXS (6%) for potential downside protection.
Add XLV (6%) for defensive sector exposure.
This aggressive plan seeks higher growth through concentration.
Expect higher volatility and potential for larger drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive mode aims for stretched growth by concentrating exposure and adding inverse ETFs for hedging. Expect a target return of around 4% per month, but with significantly higher volatility and the potential for substantial drawdowns due to leverage and concentrated bets. Leveraged ETF decay is a factor.

plan: Sell all high-beta tech and leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MUU, MSFU, PLTU, SPAL).
Increase QQQI allocation to 30% for income.
Focus on income-generating ETFs and broad index.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions.
Expect low volatility and reliable income.
NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
income.read: This income mode prioritizes steady monthly distributions by selling high-beta tech and leveraged ETFs. Expect a target return of around 1% per month, with very low volatility. While distributions are prioritized, the Net Asset Value (NAV) can still fall in a market downturn.
